item.title: 🟠 AI Recommendation Poisoning: How "Ask AI" Buttons Silently Alter LLM Memory
item.description:

A new class of prompt injection is spreading across commercial websites. It requires no malware, no stolen credentials, and no zero-day exploit. item.title: 🔴 Ransom Cartel Creator Gets 16 Years in Prison for Operating Ransomware-as-a-Service
item.description:
Why this matters: Elevated ransomware risk — validate backups and endpoint defenses.
A federal judge in Alexandria, Virginia, sentenced Maksim Silnikau to 16 years in prison on August 5 for creating and running Ransom Cartel, the ransomware-as-a-service operation he stood up in 2021. Between 2021 and 2023, Ransom Cartel conspirators attacked at least 18 companies, including firms in California, New York and Nebraska, and others abroad, according to the Justice Department.

Source: The Hacker News  |  Severity: Critical  |  Age: 6h ago

item.title: 🔴 CISA Flags TeamCity CVE-2026-63077 RCE Flaw Under Active Exploitation in the Wild
item.description:

item.title: 🔴 Snowflake Hacker Pleads Guilty Over Breaches Affecting at Least 100 Million People
item.description:
